china_race_dynamics.text:
Solving the AI security debate starts with Congress ensuring every line of federal source code purchased is written and managed by Americans in America.

No more outsourcing to China, Malaysia, or Vietnam with your tax dollars.  America First Source Code must be the new standard.

My OpEd  @WashTimes

https://t.co/RlE7y7f4t8

deepseek.reason: The statement proposes source-code sourcing restrictions but does not frame competition with China as the AI policy priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The China exclusion is explicit, but the race-dynamics link is inferential.

astra.reason: The speaker advocates domestic federal source-code procurement for security rather than prioritizing AI competition with China.
astra.confidence_reason: China is named as an outsourcing destination, but the statement does not explicitly frame the policy as competition with China.

china_race_dynamics.text: Hong Kong police had access to AI facial-recognition tools, and the crackdown that followed accelerated the expansion of camera networks under mainland China’s high-tech surveillance model.

deepseek.reason: The statement describes Chinese surveillance tools without addressing US competition policy.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It is purely descriptive about Hong Kong and mainland China.
